controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.content: The data controller for personal data collected on this website is Antonio Más Gutiérrez (AMG Digitalitzacions).

dataCollected.title: 2. Data collected
dataCollected.content: We collect: name and surname, email address, phone number, and billing information when services are contracted.

purpose.title: 3. Purpose of processing
purpose.content: Data is processed for: managing quote requests, providing contracted services, sending commercial communications (with prior consent), and complying with legal obligations.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal basis
legalBasis.content: The legal basis for data processing is: execution of a service contract, consent of the data subject, and compliance with legal obligations.

rights.title: 5. Data subject rights
rights.content: Users may exercise their rights of access, rectification, deletion, restriction, portability and objection by emailing info@amgdl.com.

security.title: 6. Security measures
security.content: We apply appropriate technical and organisational security measures to protect personal data, including AES-256 encryption for sensitive data and role-based access control.

subprocessors.title: 7. Sub-processors
subprocessors.content: To provide services, AMG Digitalitzacions uses the following sub-processors: Brevo SAS (transactional email, EU-based); Twilio Inc. (WhatsApp and SMS messaging, US-based); Anthropic PBC (text processing for AI agents, US-based); GoCardless Ltd (SEPA direct debit, UK-based); Hetzner Online GmbH (servers and hosting, Germany-based). Each provider has signed appropriate contractual guarantees.

internationalTransfers.title: 8. International transfers
internationalTransfers.content: Some providers (Twilio, Anthropic) are based in the United States. These transfers are carried out with the appropriate safeguards under Art. 46 GDPR, specifically Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission. Data processed by AI agents (Anthropic) is limited to the conversation content necessary to generate responses and is not used to train models.

retention.title: 9. Retention periods
retention.content: Contact data (CRM leads) is retained while an active commercial relationship exists and up to 3 years from the last contact. Billing data is retained for 7 years as required by tax law. Agent conversation logs are retained for 12 months. Upon exercising the right to erasure, personal identifying data is anonymised within a maximum of 30 days.

automatedProcessing.title: 10. Automated processing and AI agents
automatedProcessing.content: The platform includes AI agents that can automatically respond to WhatsApp, Telegram or email messages on behalf of the tenant. These automated responses only occur when the end customer has initiated the conversation. No automated decisions with significant legal effects are made. You may request that your queries be handled by a human by emailing info@amgdl.com.

meta.title: Automated quote follow-up for businesses · Mallorca | AMG Digitalitzacions
meta.description: No quote left unanswered. PDF generation, automatic follow-up and approval tracking via WhatsApp. From 59€/month.

pressupostos.subtitle: For builders, installers, architects, photographers and any business that works with custom quotes. The agent generates them, follows up and records responses — so you don't lose jobs because you didn't call in time.
pressupostos.problemHeadline: A quote without follow-up is a lost job.

problems.title: Quotes that get forgotten
problems.desc: You send it, days pass, and nobody follows up.

problems.title: No visibility on interest
problems.desc: You have no way of knowing who opened it or who is undecided.

problems.title: Hours quoting manually
problems.desc: Time taken away from real work to draft and send documents.

pressupostos.solutionsHeadline: Generate, send and follow up. Automatically.

solutions.title: Automatic PDF quotes
solutions.desc: The agent generates the quote in PDF with your format and sends it to the client immediately, via WhatsApp or email.

solutions.title: Follow-up on no replies
solutions.desc: If the client doesn't respond, the agent follows up on its own on the days you set, with the right message each time.

solutions.title: Response tracking
solutions.desc: You always know who accepted, who's undecided and who said no. All logged automatically.

solutions.title: Client reactivation
solutions.desc: The agent recovers past clients and half-finished quotes, automatically.

faqs.q: Can I use my own quote format?
faqs.a: Yes. The agent generates PDFs with your design and your data.

faqs.q: How often does it follow up?
faqs.a: You decide: for example at day 2 and day 5. The agent does it on its own with the tone you want.

faqs.q: Will clients feel harassed by a robot?
faqs.a: No. The messages are natural and you can stop or join the thread whenever you like.

faqs.q: How long does it take to go live?
faqs.a: The website is published within 48h and the quote system is configured in phases.

meta.description: Filter repetitive queries and get your time back. The agent answers common questions, qualifies leads and only passes through what matters. From 59€/month.

despatxos.subtitle: For accountancy firms, law offices, consultancies and professional services. The agent answers routine questions, qualifies contacts and only passes through the enquiries that truly need your attention.
despatxos.problemHeadline: The time you waste answering the same thing over and over.

problems.title: The same questions every day
problems.desc: Documents, deadlines, what do I need for... Always the same.

problems.title: Calls that go nowhere
problems.desc: People asking about things outside your scope or who will never hire you.

problems.title: Queries that fall through the cracks
problems.desc: Messages that arrive outside office hours and by the time you see them it's too late.

solutions.title: Automatic FAQ answers
solutions.desc: The agent answers routine questions 24/7: documentation, deadlines, hours, prices. You stop repeating yourself.

solutions.title: Lead qualification
solutions.desc: Before passing anyone to you, the agent collects the key information and filters out what doesn't fit.

solutions.title: Document collection
solutions.desc: The agent requests and collects the documents you need from each client, in an organised and automatic way.

solutions.title: Follow-up & reminders
solutions.desc: Deadlines, renewals, expiries. The agent alerts the client (and you) before it's too late.

faqs.q: Can the agent give sensitive or legal information?
faqs.a: No. It answers general questions and collects information; substantive matters always go through you.

faqs.q: Does it connect with my management tools?
faqs.a: We work with what you already use whenever possible, or we suggest alternatives.

faqs.q: Does the client know when they're talking to a person?
faqs.a: Yes, and you can jump into the thread at any time. Hybrid bot + human mode.

faqs.q: How long does it take to go live?
faqs.a: The website is published within 48h and the agent is configured in phases for your office.

meta.description: Cut no-shows and stop managing your schedule manually. Automated bookings, reminders and WhatsApp confirmations. From 59€/month.

citaPrevia.subtitle: For physiotherapists, clinics, beauty centres, vets and any business that works with prior appointments. Automated bookings, reminders and WhatsApp confirmations — without you having to answer every message.
citaPrevia.problemHeadline: Every empty slot is money you won't get back.

problems.title: No-shows
problems.desc: The patient who doesn't show up leaves a gap you can't fill.

problems.title: Manually managed schedule
problems.desc: Hours every day confirming appointments by WhatsApp between clients.

problems.title: Clients who don't come back
problems.desc: They finish treatment and disappear, with no follow-up from anyone.

citaPrevia.solutionsHeadline: An agent that works when you can't.

solutions.title: Automatic reminders
solutions.desc: The agent sends a reminder the day before and asks for confirmation. If the client can't make it, the slot opens up for someone else.

solutions.title: WhatsApp bookings 24/7
solutions.desc: Clients book on their own, at any hour, without you having to reply. The schedule updates itself.

solutions.title: Client reactivation
solutions.desc: The agent detects who hasn't visited in a while and proposes a return, automatically.

solutions.title: Automatic reviews
solutions.desc: After each visit, the agent asks for a Google review. More ratings, more new clients.

faqs.q: Does it connect with my current booking system?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with the tools you already use, or we set up a new one if you prefer.

faqs.q: Does the client notice they're talking to a bot?
faqs.a: The agent replies naturally, and you can jump into the conversation at any time in the same thread.

faqs.q: How long does it take to go live?
faqs.a: The website is published within 48h and the agent is configured in phases according to your needs.

faqs.q: What if I want to change something?
faqs.a: The system evolves with you: we implement adjustments and improvements when you need them, within your plan.
